reviews.title: English Audio Reading French Words Not Good
reviews.text: I set up the app to ostensibly teach me intermediate-level French vocabulary. The French words appeared in individual cards with French synonyms and example sentences. All fine so far. But when I pressed the audio pronunciation button next to the French vocab words, the built-in text-to-speech reader was an English voice which wrecked the pronunciation of the French words. This made the app essentially useless for my purposes. Unfortunate to say the least.

reviews.title: Data tracking
reviews.text:
Sketchy they want to track you across the different apps and websites you use: your user id, device id, usage data, and diagnostics. Instant delete. 

Edit: don’t believe their response, they would not be required to ask for consent if they didn’t track your data across services owned by other companies. 

Edit again: the person responding to reviews clearly doesn’t understand data tracking across apps and websites from other companies, sketchy when your app is doing it and it’s literally disclosed on your product page ha
